ruflo.release_body:
## What changed

Fixes Finding B of #3327: `memory_search({ smart: true })` was reporting SmartRetrieval's internal RRF fusion score in the `similarity` field instead of the underlying retrieval relevance score — e.g. a raw retrieval relevance of `0.8` was showing up as `0.03252247488101534`.

- `similarity` now carries the raw retrieval relevance (matches `smart: false` behavior)
- the fused SmartRetrieval ranking score is now exposed separately as `rankingScore`
- `threshold` behavior is unchanged (still applied pre-RRF/MMR/recency)
- 14 new regression tests across the SmartRetrieval package and MCP handler

Fixed in #3340 (thanks @takagibit18).

Finding A of #3327 (reasoningBank/vectorBackend reporting `enabled:true` but routing through `bridge-fallback`) remains open and unclaimed.

## Note on version history

3.42.1–3.42.3 were published to npm without matching version-bump commits on `main`. Verified their tags (`v3.42.0`, `v3.42.1`, `v3.42.3`) are all ancestors of this release, so 3.42.4 is a strict superset of everything previously shipped.

Co-Authored-By: RuFlo <ruv@ruv.net>
ruflo.commit_message:
chore(release): 3.42.0 -> 3.42.4 — smart search score semantics fix (#3327/#3340)

Ships PR #3340 (fix(memory): preserve retrieval relevance in smart search
results): memory_search({smart:true}) was returning the RRF fusion score in
the `similarity` field instead of the underlying retrieval relevance;
`similarity` now carries the raw retrieval score, and the fused SmartRetrieval
ranking score is exposed separately as `rankingScore`.

Note: 3.42.1-3.42.3 were published to npm without matching version-bump
commits on main (no `chore(release)` commit, gitHead unset in npm metadata).
Verified via `v3.42.0`/`v3.42.1`/`v3.42.3` git tags: all are ancestors of this
commit, so 3.42.4 is a strict superset of what was previously published.

Co-Authored-By: RuFlo <ruv@ruv.net>

docs(changelog): add v0.5.0 release entry (2026-09-18) (MUL-7481) (#8543)

* docs(changelog): add v0.5.0 release entry (2026-09-18) (MUL-7481)

Adds the 0.5.0 changelog entry to all four landing locales and bumps the
web and desktop app versions.

Range v0.4.44 → 594ff89 (55 PRs). Minor bump because the release ships
full French product UI, which is worth announcing on its own.

Left out of the changelog, as agreed on MUL-7481: Triage (triage_v1 not
rolled out), the plugins_v1 / billing_workspace_subscriptions gate error
semantics, UI Lab, CI/test/docs, prompt and skill changes, the Issue
status category migration, and internal performance work.

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

* docs(changelog): retitle the v0.5.0 entry around agent behavior (MUL-7481)

The title listed the top of `features` and carried a small feature
(Autopilot schedule editing) while leaving out the day's agent work.

Drop the small feature, keep the French UI, and put the agent side in:
runs are both steadier (Grok/Pi/Copilot/Codex/Cursor/Hermes, durable
terminal reports) and leaner — a resumed agent no longer re-reads the
whole Issue and every comment (#8377, #8488). That last one now has its
own improvements line so the title stays backed by the entry.

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

---------

Co-authored-by: Sol-Boy <sol-boy@multica-ai.local>

orca.commit_message:
test(mobile): make the bridged recording-corpus replay a CI gate and pin the C1 page closure (OTA phase C, C1.6) (#21533)

* test(mobile): the bridged corpus replay is a gate, not an opt-in flag (OTA phase C, C1.6)

`rpc-recording-through-bridge.test.ts` replays all 787 goldens through the page
bridge and pins how far that bridge is from byte-identical. It only ran when
`RPC_FOUNDATION_BRIDGE=1` was set, which CI did in a step of its own. A gate
whose CI job has to remember to set a variable is opt-in, and a branch that
widened the divergence with that step edited away would have been measured by
nobody.

The suite now runs by default and `RPC_FOUNDATION_BRIDGE=0` skips it, for a
local run that does not want the three minutes. `BRIDGED_PARITY_OFF` names the
one value that skips, so an unset or mistyped variable still runs the gate.

The dedicated CI step goes with it: `pnpm test` collects the file already, so
keeping the step would have run the same 788 tests twice in one job. Vitest
gives the file a worker beside the rest of the suite, so the marginal wall time
is a fraction of the ~3 min it takes alone.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JNnE9qzUZMMnqpZWCqM3nb

* test(mobile): pin the bridged verdict of every C1-page-closure golden by id (OTA phase C, C1.6)

The bridged replay certifies the corpus in counts over 787 goldens, and a count
is the wrong instrument for the claim C1 needs. C1 moves one domain to the web:
`app/h/_layout.tsx`, `app/h/[hostId]/index.tsx` and their import closure. A
golden recorded at a call site in there that stopped replaying byte-identically
is paid for by any of the other 684 that started, and every existing assertion
still passes.

`c1-page-closure.ts` names the 22 families and 103 goldens of that closure and
pins each one to the verdict it gives: 54 byte-identical, 49 in four of the five
classes the suite already excludes, all of them recorder observation artifacts
whose wire bytes C0.5 and C0.8 proved identical. Membership is checked per
family, not against the flat id list, so a golden newly derived into a family
this domain owns arrives as a finding instead of being missed for never having
been pinned. A closure golden may only be excluded into a class that carries a
reason in `BRIDGED_PARITY_EXCLUSIONS`.

Two full-corpus assertions go with it. `identical` was a floor; it is now the
exact 787 minus the excluded classes. And the run's own size is pinned to the
corpus: every class is an upper bound, so without that a corpus that lost
goldens outside the identical set satisfied all of them.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JNnE9qzUZMMnqpZWCqM3nb

* test(mobile): move a closure golden to a verdict it is not already pinned to (OTA phase C, C1.6)

The drift test took whichever golden the pin lists first and moved it to
`params-undefined`. Nothing said that golden was not pinned to that class
already, and the day one is, the test asserts a change it never made. Pick the
first golden whos

GenericAgent Desktop 桌面版 / Desktop

三个平台产物来自同一提交，并在公开发布前统一验证。All three platform artifacts come from one commit and are validated before publication.

## 安装方法 / Installation
- Windows x64：下载 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`，解压后双击 `GenericAgent.exe`。卸载时运行 `uninstall.bat`，再删除解压目录。
  Windows x64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`, then launch `GenericAgent.exe`. Run `uninstall.bat` before deleting the extracted directory.
- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。
  Linux x86_64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`, run `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage`, then launch it. Run `uninstall.sh` before deleting the extracted directory.
- macOS Apple silicon (arm64)：打开 `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg`，把 `GenericAgent.app` 拖入 Applications。
  macOS Apple silicon (arm64): open `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg` and drag `GenericAgent.app` to Applications.

## 签名状态 / Signing status
Windows 便携版尚未使用代码签名证书，SmartScreen 可能显示警告；运行前请核对 `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`。
The Windows portable build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt` before running it.

macOS 应用仅使用 ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Apple Developer ID，也未 notarize。首次打开可能需要右键选择“打开”或在“隐私与安全性”中允许。
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed only. It is neither Developer ID signed nor notarized; first launch may require Open from the context menu or approval in Privacy & Security.

SHA-256 清单与各产物一同发布。SHA-256 manifests are included with the artifacts.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.6.18

Released: 2026-09-17

## English

### Highlights

- Mobile now distinguishes working, idle, exception and unread Agent states
  across Agent/window selectors and project lists. Selection stays independent
  of activity; chat spacing is tighter without replacing the existing dual modes.
- Settings offers three offline background images, custom local images,
  previews and content opacity. Saved backgrounds survive app restart.

### Fixes and reliability

- Integrates #350 with additional local qualification: private macOS Keychains,
  one-way inherited Claude/AGY credentials, legacy Claude auth provenance
  migration and explicit-key OAuth-metadata isolation.
- Includes #353 and a compatibility correction: custom Codex endpoints bind
  available API keys through env_key without requiring keys for unauthenticated
  endpoints or enabling disabled environment inheritance.
- Claude managed API-key approval now includes explicit profile/Agent keys and
  permitted inherited credentials instead of relying only on managed settings.
  External Provider configuration and login state remain untouched.

### Upgrade notes and limitations

- Upgrade CCB and the Mobile APK to `v8.6.18`. Restart affected managed Agents
  when idle to regenerate private configuration. No manual pairing migration
  or changes to external Provider credentials are required.
- Mobile validation: 838 tests passed, 1 existing skip; final thumbnail styling
  passed 10 focused tests. Authentication follow-ups passed 380 related tests.
- macOS sleep/idle Keychain GUI behavior still requires native user retesting;
  Linux tests do not establish that acceptance. Windows remains beta with
  existing prerequisites. OpenAI-only endpoints do not become Claude-compatible.

## 中文

### 版本亮点

- 手机端在 Agent、窗口选择器和项目列表中区分工作中、空闲、异常及未读。
  选中状态与工作状态独立，对话间距更紧凑，保留原有对话/终端双模式。
- 设置中增加三款离线背景图片，保留本机自定义图片、预览和内容不透明度；
  已保存背景在应用重启后恢复。

### 修复与稳定性

- 整合 #350 并加入本地复核修正：macOS 私有 Keychain、Claude/AGY 凭据
  单向继承、旧版 Claude 认证来源迁移，以及显式密钥不继承 OAuth 账户元数据。
- 包含 #353 及兼容补丁：Codex 自定义端点通过 env_key 绑定可用密钥，
  不再为无鉴权端点强制要求密钥，也不绕过禁用环境继承的设置。
- Claude managed API Key 审批覆盖显式 profile/Agent 密钥和允许继承的凭据，
  不再仅依赖 managed settings；不修改外部 Provider 配置或登录状态。

### 升级说明与限制

- 将 CCB 和手机 APK 升级到 `v8.6.18`。相关 Agent 空闲后正常重启，以重新生成
  私有配置；无需手动迁移配对或修改外部 Provider 凭据。
- 手机端验证：838 项通过、1 项原有跳过；最终缩略图样式通过 10 项定向测试。
  认证后续修复通过 380 项相关测试。
- macOS 睡眠/空闲后的 Keychain 弹窗仍需用户原生实机复测，Linux 测试不能
  替代该验收。Windows 保持 beta 及既有依赖要求。仅支持 OpenAI 协议的端点
  不会因此自动兼容 Claude 协议。

> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
